3. The defendant Nos. 3-5 contested the suit by filing a written statement denying all material allegations contending, inter-alia, that Nil Kanta Mondal was the owner  of the schedule,-'Ka' property and the C.S. Khatian was also prepared in his name. Nil Kanta Mondal died leaving his son, Mohim Chandra Mondal and the said 'Mohim Chandra Mondal while possessing the suit land died leaving his sons namely Krishna Mohan Mondal and Mona Mohan Mondal. Krishna Mohan Mondal died unmarried in 1964 leaving his brother Monti Mohan Mondal. Thereafter, Mono Mohan Monal died unmarried in 1964 leaving his brother Mona Mohan Mondal. Thereafter, Mona Mohan Mondal died leaving sons namely Amor Chand and Adhor Chand. Amor Chand and Adhor Chand by registered deeds dated 8th September, 1980 transferred the schedule-'Ka' property to their predecessor Abdul Baset Miah. After such purchase their predecessor went to the Revenue Officer for mutation of his name but the Revenue Officer refused to mutate his name on the  plea that the said property were enlisted as vested And non-resident property. Thereafter, their predecessor prayed before the then Sub-Division Officer for releasing the suit property from the list of vested property. The Sub-Divisional Officer on being satisfied recommended for releasing the property to the Deputy Commissioner. There was an inquiry into the matter and ultimately the Land Administration Board by order dated 17th November, 1983 released the property from the list of the vested and Non-resident property. Thereafter, one Amina Hoque filed an application before the Land Administrative Board for review of the judgment and order dated 23rd October, 1991 which allowed the review petition and cancelled the earlier order dated 17th November, 1983. Thereafter, their predecessor instituted Writ Petition No. 2718 of 1991 in the High Court Division challenging the reviewing order of the Land Administrative Board. The High Court Division upon hearing the parties made the Rule absolute declaring the older of the Land Administration Board as had been made without lawful authority. Thereafter, the then Additional Deputy Commissioner (Review) unsuccessfully moved Civil Petition No. 166 of 1998 before this Court. Their predecessor there upon mutated his name, paid rent to the Government and possessed the suit property till his death. The suit properties are not vested and non-resident properly and the suit is not legally maintainable. 

 5. It appears that the suit property belonged on Nil Kanta Mondal. The plaintiffs did not say anything regarding the recording of the suit property in the C.S.Khatian in the name of Nil Kanta. Their basis of claim is S.A. Khatian which has no presumptive value. Krishna Mohan Mondal and Mona Mohan Mondal are the sons of Nil Kanta Mondal. The defendants have purchased the suit property from their heirs of Mona Mohan Mondal who is admittedly a co-sharer in the suit plot. Even if the defendants failed to prove that Krishna Mohan Mondal died in 1964 in this country, Mona Mohan Mondal being a co-sharer in the said Khatian his sons legally inherited at least half share of the suit property. Since Amor Chand and Adhor Chand are the legal heirs of Mona Mohan Mondal; the defendants have acquired title on the strength of Ext. Ga' series and therefore, the plaintiff cannot claim that they are not hound by the said deeds. It further appears that after the execution of the deeds, their predecessor went to the local revenue office mutation and payment of rent when the revenue officer disclosed that the suit property was enlisted as vested and non-resident property and refused to accept the rent. Thereafter, their predecessor filed an application before the then Sub-Divisional Officer 'for releasing the suit property from the list of vested and non-resident property and that on the recommendation of the then Sub-Divisional officer through the Additional Deputy Commissioner, the Land Administration Board released the suit property from the list of vested and non-resident  property On 17th November, 1987. It appears from the ext-'Gha' that the High Court Division declared the cancellation of the order releasing the suit property from the list of vested and non-resident property as illegal and void. P.W.1 in course of cross-examination admitted the said facts.
